messages:
Jordan: FYI: TrialTenant is ready for a hosted POC. They need an API key with short TTL for security review. Can infra provision an ephemeral key (48h) and an IP allowlist? cc @Maya for SOC requirements
Alex: Got it. Do we need IP CIDR ranges or just a public IP? Also any special scopes (embeddings/generation)?
Jordan: They will hit generation + embeddings. IPs: 34.82.15.0/24 and 3.14.15.0/24. No other external access.
Maya: Security: we require 1) ephemeral key TTL <=48h, 2) revocation window documented, 3) audit log retention for POC (7d), 4) no long-lived secrets in chat. Use service-account flow if possible.
Samir: I'll create a scoped ephemeral key with generation+embed. Not posting raw key here. Creating now...
infra-bot: provisioning-request accepted: req_id=pr-8821, owner=Samir, env=trial-tenant
Samir: Key created: ID=kt-ppq9, TTL=48h, scope=[generate,embed], allowlist=[34.82.15.0/24,3.14.15.0/24]. I've uploaded the rotation playbook to the POC ticket.
Jordan: thanks. Can you share the rotation and revoke commands we should give the customer? They'll do a test rotate at 24h.
Samir: sure — share this snippet (never paste keys into slack):

```
# rotate
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/keys/kt-ppq9/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN_TOKEN"

# revoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/keys/kt-ppq9/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Replace $REDWOOD_ADMIN_TOKEN with your org admin token. Rotation returns a new key id and TTL header.
Maya: Add: rotation must be done via the admin console or the admin API; ensure customers confirm cutover and update SDKs. Also capture evidence of rotation for SOC-2 checklist.
Alex: I'll update the POC runbook with the test steps and add the IPs to the allowlist config. Who will notify the customer about the revocation plan?
Jordan: I'll ping them and include the runbook link. Quick check Samir — after revoke, do we auto-expire any cached tokens? (they use a local proxy)
Samir: Revoke invalidates tokens server-side immediately; clients might cache until local TTL but requests will fail. Recommend client restart or clear cache.
Jordan: Perfect. Meera from sales will run validation tomorrow and confirm. :thumbsup:
Meera: Confirmed — I'll schedule the rotate test and send an update here after it's done.
infra-bot: provisioning-complete: req_id=pr-8821, status=active, expires=+48h
Samir: Closing loop — recorded in ticket #TICKET-719. If anything else pops up, escalate to eng-platform.
Jordan: Great work team, thanks. :rocket:
